lines.text: Her beloved knocks at night, his head drenched with dew, and she says she has taken off her robe.
She rises to open the door, but her beloved has turned and gone, and he does not answer her call.
The watchmen beat her and take her sandals; she asks the daughters to tell him she is sick with love.
She calls him outstanding among ten thousand, with a head of purest gold and legs on bases of silver.
She says he has gone to his garden to gather lilies, and that they belong to each other.
